mappings.evidence_quote: Decisioning requires monthly gross income in GBP.
mappings.reasoning: Both values represent gross income in GBP. The source is annual and the target is monthly, so the approved annual_to_monthly transformation divides the annual amount by 12.
assumptions: annual_gross_income_gbp covers a full 12-month period, so dividing by 12 gives a representative monthly figure.
No rounding is applied; the decisioning workflow's expected precision has not been stated.

mappings.evidence_quote: Applicant age must be 18 or older on the application submission date.
mappings.reasoning: The dictionary has no age field. Age in completed years can be derived from date_of_birth and the application submission date recorded in submitted_at.
assumptions: The application submission date is the calendar date of submitted_at in UTC.
FieldBridge supplies age only; the 18-or-older eligibility rule is applied by the decisioning workflow.

mappings.evidence_quote: Capture the date and time at which the applicant gave consent.
mappings.reasoning: No field in the data dictionary records when consent was given. submitted_at records application submission and must not be treated as the time consent was given.

open_questions: Which source field records the exact consent time, and in which timezone?
